blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The Sangguniang Panglalawigan of Surigao del Sur has set a public hearing on a proposed provincial measure banning lewd shows in cockpit arenas following public outrage over a viral video showing scantily clad women performing inside a local gallera in Cantilan town. In a notice dated Oct. 14, 2026, the provincial board’s Committee on Laws and Justice and Human Rights scheduled the public hearing for Monday, October 19, at the Legislative Building Session Hall in Capitol Hills, Barangay Telaje in Tandag City.
